# quarBreach

An R package for exploring COVID-19 quarantine breach risk based on
Zachreson et al. (2022).

## Purpose

Helps public-health students explore how vaccine efficacy, community
vaccination coverage, and the basic reproduction number (R0) interact to
determine quarantine breach risk and expected time to a community
outbreak.

## Data

- `breach_scenarios`: four scenarios from Table 1 of Zachreson et
  al. (2022)
- `outbreak_timing`: outbreak horizon (t95) across efficacy x coverage x
  R0

Source: Zachreson et al. (2022) *Science Advances* 8(14): eabm3624.

## Installation

``` r

devtools::install_github("ETC5523-2026/etc5523-assignment-4-urvijoshi18",
                         subdir = "quarBreach")
```

## Launch the app

``` r

library(quarBreach)
launch_app()
```

## Use the summary function

``` r

summarise_breach_risk()
summarise_breach_risk(r0 = 6)
```

# Package index

## Launch the app

- [`launch_app()`](launch_app.md) : Launch the quarBreach Shiny app

## Summary functions

- [`summarise_breach_risk()`](summarise_breach_risk.md) : Summarise
  quarantine breach risk scenarios

## Data

- [`breach_scenarios`](breach_scenarios.md) : Quarantine breach risk
  under four COVID-19 scenarios
- [`outbreak_timing`](outbreak_timing.md) : Outbreak timing by efficacy,
  coverage, and transmissibility
